intro: Lonebrow's Journal is an Alliance quest initiated by finding a weathered book held in the hand of a dead dwarf at the base of the Great Lift in Thousand Needles. The notes detail his final journey and prompt the finder to deliver the volume west to a night elf druid stationed on the Feralas border.
